annotations.title: Appeal a staff hold on warmup

description: Ask our team to lift the hold on this mailbox's warmup, in your own words. One appeal waits at a time: a second waits for the first's decision. Nothing held is a 409, and so is an appeal already waiting.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

reason.description: Why the block should be lifted, in your own words. Staff reads it with the block's reason.
